name: Mordageen
description: The Mordageen were a sentient species from the planet Mordagon. The species was bipedal in form with pink skin and pointed ears. One notorious Mordageen was the smuggler Bendix Fust, who worked for the Dug crime lord Sebolto. Captured by Republic Security Forces, Fust revealed all he knew of his employer's organization, and was placed in Desolation Alley, a prison on Oovo IV. There, he was broken out by two bounty hunters so that Sebolto could get his revenge.

data.name: Mordageen
data.distinctions: Pointed ears, flat noses, wrinkled skin
